description: This file defines a React functional component named MCPServerEdit used for editing configuration of an MCP server, including server details, authentication, permission management, cost configuration, and tool configuration in a web UI. It imports several external libraries and internal components to facilitate complex form handling, OAuth flow, and interactions with backend services.

methods.name: fetchTools
methods.description: Fetches the list of tools available on the MCP server, using the current access token and OAuth token if applicable.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Validates and submits the form data to update the MCP server configuration via backend API.

methods.name: getAccessGroupOptions
methods.description: Generates the options for selecting access groups, including a dynamic option for creating new groups.

methods.name: persistEditUiState
methods.description: Saves the current UI state of editing to sessionStorage to restore in case of page reload.
